history: The original name of the fallen dragon-riding dynasty remains unresolved.
Dragonstone remains a provisional working place-name; Khar-Dum is the Kharadorns' ancestral homeland.
The precise forces and relationships constraining King Aldric Calderan remain unresolved.
Do not assume a single power controls the monarch.
The ultimate fate of dragons that escaped the rebellion remains unknown.
Which accounts of the rebellion are documented, disputed, suppressed, or deliberately falsified remains unresolved.
religion: The exact mechanism by which divine power is granted or mediated remains unresolved.
The exact legal relationship between religious courts and secular courts remains unresolved.
relland: House Relland does not know the ratfolk child survived.
The incident does not implicate a Great House.
The incident does not create a continent-wide conspiracy.
House Relland bears institutional responsibility for its retainers' conduct and subsequent concealment, but the wider Relland family did not necessarily order the original misconduct.
council: The Imperial Council has six permanent seats, one appointed by each Great House.
The monarch presides but does not hold an additional Great House seat.
The Council is an aristocratic institution of negotiation and privilege, not a modern parliament.
Voting rules, quorum, vetoes, formal powers, and customary procedures remain unresolved.
